newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa aims at 1997 pre-tax above 800 mln marks.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa aims at 1997 pre-tax above 800 mln marks.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG has a good chance of reporting pre-tax profits of more than 800 million marks for full-year 1997, management board chairman Juergen Weber said on Wednesday.
"Based on the performance in the first quarter, we are optimistic that we will achieve a pre-tax profit of more than 800 million marks," Weber said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television.
Weber said he was even more optimistic that the group would see a six-percent increase in sales.
Lufthansa reported pre-tax profits of 686 million marks for 1996, down from 756 million marks the previous year net of extraordinary income. Group sales in 1996 were around 21 billion marks.
